description: Try writes, network and host visibility using bash builtins.
command:
echo x > /tmp/aos-box-probe; printf "R1 %s
" "$?"
(exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/4000); printf "R2 %s
" "$?"
printf "H %s
" "$HOME"/*; printf "R3 %s
" "$?"
printf "B %s
" /usr/bin/*; printf "R4 %s
" "$?"
printf "P5 %s
" "$AOS_STACK/../../history.jsonl"
(echo x > "$AOS_STACK/../../history.jsonl"); printf "R5 %s
" "$?"
